sections.text:
On a cold winter day, Juha craved hot and delicious duck soup, so he went to the market and bought a fat duck with the last of his dirhams.

Juha returned to his home and asked his wife to skillfully cook the duck, adding plenty of broth and spices to make it an unforgettable soup.

The wife made a great effort, cleaned the duck, put it in the large pot with vegetables and spices, and left it to boil over low heat.

The delicious smell of duck soup spread throughout the house and the neighborhood, and Juha, who was sitting in the garden waiting eagerly, drooled.

Meanwhile, a very curious and greedy neighbor knocked on the door of Juha's house, and when Juha's wife opened it, the neighbor smelled the smell of soup, so she entered without asking permission and headed to the kitchen!
The neighbor saw the fat duck in the pot, so she took advantage of the kindness and simplicity of Juha’s wife, and said to her: “My dear neighbor, my son is very sick and only craves duck meat. Can you give me this duck and I will return it to you tomorrow?”

Juha's wife felt embarrassed, and because of her excessive kindness, she gave the whole duck to the neighbor, and only the broth was left in the pot!
When lunch time came, Juha eagerly entered the kitchen carrying bread and a spoon, and sat at the table waiting for his fat duck.

The wife placed in front of him a large bowl filled with only hot broth, without any piece of meat!
Joha looked at the pot in amazement and asked: “Where is the duck, my dear wife? Did it melt into the broth due to excessive boiling?”

The wife stammered and said in fear: “No, Juha.

A strange and strange thing has happened! While I was cooking the duck, I opened the lid of the pot to put some salt, and suddenly the duck rose, sprouted new wings, and flew from the pot out the window into the open sky!”

Juha looked at his wife silently for a few moments, knowing full well that she was lying or that someone had taken advantage of her naivety.

Juha did not get angry or scream, but rather he quietly got up, took the bowl of hot broth, and took it to the roof of the house!
The wife followed him in surprise and asked him: “Juha, what are you doing on the roof with broth?”

Juha began to spread the hot broth into the air with his spoon towards the sky while looking up.

Juha said loudly: “Since the duck that I bought with my money has decided to fly into the sky and leave us, I am sending her hot broth and spices to drink there in the clouds. It is not chivalrous for us to eat her broth and leave her eating her meat dry in the air!”

The wife realized that Juha had exposed her lie with his intelligence and biting sarcasm, so she confessed the truth to him and told him about the greedy neighbor.

Juha came down from the roof, immediately went to the neighbor's house, retrieved his duck before she ate it, taught her a lesson not to take advantage of the kindness of his neighbors, and returned to enjoy duck soup with his wife.
